A '''massacre''' took place in [[Yellowblade's Landing]], on the planet [[Orto Norwe]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Let me do the talking, brother.| Darth Maul speaking to [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage]] upon entering the Cantina|<ref name="CC1" />}}
After the escape of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] during the [[Skirmish above Raydonia/Legends|Skirmish above Raydonia]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] landed on [[Orto Norwe]] to begin building their army. Upon entering a [[Unidentified cantina (Yellowblade's Landing)|cantina]] in [[Yellowblade's Landing]], they began to look for the rally outpost's owner. The Bartender directed Maul to [[Nukss]], who led the local gang known as [[The Scourge]]. After threatening Savage and Maul to either join the gang or pay them money, Maul returned with another threat; that they either join them, or [[Death/Legends|die]].

==The Massacre==
{{Quote|I offer you another choice. Serve us....or die|Darth Maul threatening Nukss|<ref name="CC1" />}}
Once the fight began, Maul and Savage disposed of the six gang members, which left Nukss at Maul's mercy. Nukss claimed that he should be allowed serve the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]], but Maul decided to kill Nukss now that he was useless to him. However, Savage chose to leave one of them alive, so that he would warn others and bring the Jedi to them. Maul spoke out against this and told Savage that they were not yet ready to face the Jedi, and that they should hide. In order to do this, Maul said that they should leave no witnesses, and to do that, they must slay all who were inside the cantina at the time of the skirmish.

==Aftermath==
Word that the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had made their way to Yellowblade's Landing soon reached the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], where [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] learned from his informants that Maul and Savage were located there.<ref name="CC1">''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]''</ref> Plo Koon, along with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Bruu Jun-Fan]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tatsu]], and Master [[Grohto]] would come to the icy world two rotations later, and found a [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]], as well as the massacred bodies in the cantina.
